title: Felix and the Songbook
author: Tamsin Okonkwo
blurb: Mara Okafor, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
